pages.title: Walrus
pages.text: The walrus ($(o)Odobenus rosmarus$()) is a huge Arctic pinniped, instantly recognised by its long ivory tusks and bristly moustache.$(br2)It uses its sensitive whiskers to find clams on the sea floor, and its tusks to haul itself onto ice and to fight rivals.$(br2)Walruses gather in large herds, and an adult is too big and dangerous for most polar bears to attack.
